# sapintegrationsuite_partner_authorized_user (Data Source)

Reads an existing Partner Directory authorized user mapping by its communication user, without managing it as a resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sapintegrationsuite_partner_authorized_user" "commuser" {
  user = "commuser1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user` (String) The communication user to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as user.
- `partner_id` (String) The Partner ID (Pid) this user is authorized for.
